intakeRoutes.title: Intake routes
intakeRoutes.description: Where new cards of the Factory "{{name}}" land. The first enabled route that matches a card places it; a ClickUp task is imported only by a route that names its List, and everything else goes where the last route that takes every card says. Routes with an event (task status changed, task closed, pull request merged…) move a card that already exists.
